$comment: Perf-gate profile of the P7-B final scorecard (run-perf-gate.ps1 -Profile final -Slot <voice> -Clip <wav> -AppData <app data>): the shipped voice-changer defaults after the P3B commit, on CUDA, DirectML and the CPU, rows T1-T4, T7 and T9 with the targets as revised by P3B (plan -> P3B outcomes, accepted by the user; misses stay misses). It is the p3b profile (same templates, same target definitions) plus: the app's own shape (app-*: block_ms 0, the Low-latency preset as the preset button applies it), the CPU thread-policy row (sve-cpu-t6), the T4 silent rows, the T7 soak (soak-cuda, only with -Var SOAK=1: 30 minutes) and the decision sessions (only with -Var DECIDE=1, meant for -CompareVars / -CompareEnv: devblock-* the 10 ms device block, dml-shared, cpu-*-lean the CPU int8/fp32 ContentVec and thread policy). T5 (scorer v2) is the corpus runner's (scripts/bench/specs/p3b/b/run_corpus.ps1); scripts/vc-bench/final_scorecard.ps1 drives the whole scorecard with a load log per step and scripts/vc-bench/final_scorecard.py builds the tables. Every row of a gate run holds the GPU timing lock; take a quiet window (no rustc, CPU under ~25 %) and run the specs three times in rotated order (the driver does) so a slow GPU or host state hits every EP alike; targets read the median of the passes. Run it with -TargetsAdvisory for a scorecard (the gate otherwise exits 1 for the revised targets that are known misses).
name: final
description: P7-B final scorecard of the shipped voice-changer defaults: the Sigil Voice Engine on DirectML, CUDA and the CPU with the MIT default voice (or any imported template voice) at the reference config and at the app's own shape, the CPU thread-policy row, VRAM (load peak, ledger, hot_slots = 2, the GPU kNN row), cold loads, the T4 silent rows, the T7 soak and the decision sessions.
